test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What will be the cost (in Rs.) of 15.2 kg of rice if the cost of 1 kg rice is Rs. 45?
solution:
Given: 

The cost of 1 kg rice is Rs. 45

Calculation:

the cost of 15.2 kg rice = 15.2 × 45 = Rs. 684

∴ The cost of 15.2 kg rice is Rs. 684.
